en-US.title: cert900: CompTIA Practice
en-US.subtitle: Adaptive drills, free, offline
en-US.promoText: 900+ original CompTIA questions for A+ and Network+, scored on the real 100 to 900 scale. Adaptive drills run offline and every question links to a free Messer video.
en-US.description:
cert900 is a free CompTIA practice trainer for the A+ and Network+ exams. It gives you adaptive multiple-choice drills you can run anywhere, even offline, with every question linked to a free Professor Messer video so you always know where to review.

WHAT YOU GET
- 900+ original practice questions written for the current exams: A+ Core 1 (220-1201), A+ Core 2 (220-1202), and Network+ (N10-009).
- Adaptive drills that focus your practice on the objectives you miss most.
- Scoring on the real CompTIA 100 to 900 scale, so a practice score means what it will mean on exam day.
- A free Professor Messer video link on every question for fast, targeted review.
- Offline practice. Drills and your progress work without a connection.
- Optional Google sign-in to sync progress across devices and with cert900.com.
- No signup required and no paywall. The full question bank is free.

STRAIGHT ABOUT THIS VERSION
This app currently focuses on adaptive multiple-choice drills. The interactive performance-based question (PBQ) simulations that cert900 is known for on the web are not in the app yet. They are on the roadmap. For full PBQ practice today, open cert900.com in your browser.

WHO IT IS FOR
Anyone studying for CompTIA A+ or Network+ who wants honest, no-cost practice that mirrors the real scoring and points straight to trusted video explanations.

Start practicing in seconds. No account, no cost, no catch.

review.notes: Free education app. No login or account is required to use any feature. All practice content is fully accessible anonymously; Google sign-in is optional and only syncs progress across devices. Every question links to a public Professor Messer video.
